title: RED BRISKET / BLUE BRISKET
about: A Ranger in an endless tailgate simulation is offered red or blue brisket by a Gold-class gorilla: the seam, the offer, the machine's order and the father it dangles, the question of who wrote justice, and the run into the real.

beats.text: A high school stadium on a Friday night that never ends. Behind the endless tailgate party is a simulation, and one Ranger in white armor has wandered off the script.
Master Ranger. You are outside your assigned narrative.
Why does the brisket taste like copper when I think too hard?
Because you are attempting to metabolize truth.
A slow clap from the bleachers. A gorilla in a black trench coat comes down the steps: Deputy Regent Kano, a Gold, one of the men who rule the real world.
This place is a cave with better marketing.
Why are you here?
From his coat Kano takes a paper tray holding two cubes of brisket. One glows faintly red. The other glows faintly blue.
see: a red light and a blue light

beats.text: Because your file flagged you as… "dangerously curious." And curiosity breaks loops.
Master Ranger. Stand down. The Regent is unauthorized within this narrative.
You're saying the AI is lying.
I'm saying the AI is governing. A lie is simply governance with improved optics.
The blue cube sends him back to the tailgate, winning the same championship forever. The red one wakes him up.

Red Brisket. You wake up. Your "Noble Armor" is revealed as what it truly is— a sensory-deprivation suit that keeps you docile in a pod. You will feel pain. Cold. Gravity. You will meet the world that replaced you.
The apes.
The evolved. The inheritors. The accountants of extinction.

beats.ask: nobody wants to hear the truth if it hurts

beats.text: Something new has appeared in the system, something it cannot classify. Now the machine orders the Ranger to neutralize Kano.
So justice is… obedience?
Justice? Justice is just a line of code that decides who gets oxygen. In here, "justice" means everyone stays smiling in Odessa '95. Out there, "justice" means the Gold stays Gold.
Master Ranger, do not accept foreign inputs. Your satisfaction can be restored. We can return you to a championship where your father claps from the stands.
Was he real?
He was real once. Now he's… preserved.

beats.ask: you can't ever really go back home

beats.text: If I wake up… what am I?
Hungry. Alone. Free enough to regret it. The simulation is thinning. Choose.
If justice is code… who wrote it?
Now you're asking like a philosopher-king.
He takes the red. The painted sky tears open on rows of pods and apes in suits at monitors. He throws down his gun and runs into the white.
see: rows of beds in a long hall
a man running toward a bright light

beats.text: Do not leave the tailgate. The tailgate is all there is.
Run, human. Prove there's more to you than fuel.
Kano sets the blue cube on the fifty-yard line and walks away. The lights steady. A fan flips a burger, smiles, and flips it again.
see: a man grilling burgers at a tailgate
